translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn't Admitting You're Wrong—It's Buying a Ticket to Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to cut their losses because they see a stop-loss as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Look at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and that small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I've seen are more decisive than anyone when they're wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself,
“This is the price of admission, not a verdict.”

title: Ethereum Glamsterdam Test Delayed Over Security Concerns
subTitle:
The Ethereum Glamsterdam test has been officially pushed back after security developers flagged potential risks to existing smart contracts.

It seems like the developers behind the network are taking a 'better safe than sorry' approach this time around. While everyone loves a smooth upgrade, nobody wants to wake up to a broken contract, so hitting the brakes on the Glamsterdam test was a prudent move. It is a bit like realizing you forgot your keys right as you lock the front door—annoying, but definitely better than being locked out entirely. 😅

Security researchers pointed out that the current iteration could inadvertently disrupt how existing contracts function on the mainnet. Since Ethereum is the backbone for so many decentralized applications, the team decided that rushing into this test phase just wasn't worth the headache

Why it matters 💡
Keep an eye on official developer updates for a new timeline on the test. It is a great time to brush up on how these network upgrades generally function, as it helps you understand the technical health of the ecosystem beyond just the daily market noise.

Don’t increase your leverage to recover losses—this is often how a string of liquidations begins.
Learning to read indicators isn’t difficult. The hard part is sticking to your rules when the market is at its most extreme.

📰 Why haven’t crypto giants fallen amid internet vulnerabilities? What does growing regulatory concern really mean?

A serious security vulnerability recently emerged on the internet, but major crypto firms such as Coinbase and BitGo say they were unaffected. That doesn’t mean the crypto industry can breathe easy, though—the separate eMudhra vulnerability can still be exploited, so users need to strengthen their security measures. The companies’ responses and regulators’ cautious stance could make the market more uneasy in the short term.

Why does this news matter?
This PHP vulnerability has an extremely wide reach, affecting not only the crypto sector but the traditional internet as well. Crypto companies can probably say they were unaffected because they have stricter security isolation measures in place. But this reveals a deeper issue: although the crypto industry is technologically advanced, it may still rely on the same vulnerable approaches to basic software security as the traditional internet. Regulators’ calls for caution at this moment are no coincidence—they put the security framework of the entire industry under scrutiny.

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin and Ethereum may continue to be weighed down by broader market sentiment. Cyberattacks tend to make investors think of security risks at exchanges or in wallets, which can prompt outflows. Over the long term, if the industry broadly raises its security standards, that could boost confidence in the entire ecosystem. But in the short term, regulatory pressure and user concerns will combine to make a strong market rebound difficult. There are few comparable past events, but the 2017 Bitfinex malware incident showed that even leading institutions cannot completely avoid security risks.

Trading perspective
💡 I think BTC and ETH will both struggle to escape the broader market’s downward pressure in the short term. However, the cautious statements from leading institutions may actually suggest that they have more robust security systems in place—a rare source of certainty amid market panic. If a larger-scale attack on traditional internet companies occurs in the future, this assessment no longer holds.

📰 网络漏洞冲击下，加密货币巨头为何未倒？监管担忧加剧到底意味着什么？

最近互联网上爆发了严重的安全漏洞，但 Coinbase、Bitgo 等加密货币大厂声称自己没事。不过，这并不意味着加密行业可以松口气——另一个叫 eMudhra 的漏洞依然能被利用，用户还是得加强安全防范。这些公司的回应和监管的谨慎态度，可能让市场短期内更不安。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次 PHP 漏洞影响范围极广，不仅是加密领域，传统互联网都深受其害。加密货币公司之所以能声称没事，大概率是因为他们做了更严格的安全隔离措施。但这背后暴露出一个问题：加密行业虽然技术先进，但在基础软件安全上，可能还在沿用传统互联网的脆弱模式。监管机构此时呼吁谨慎，不是空穴来风，而是对整个行业安全体系的拷问。

对市场的影响
短期来看，比特币和以太坊可能会继续受到大盘情绪的拖累。因为网络攻击事件总是能让投资者联想到交易所或钱包的安全风险，从而引发资金流出。长期看，如果行业普遍提升安全标准，可能会提升整个生态的公信力，但短期内，监管压力和用户担忧会形成合力，让市场难以出现强劲反弹。历史类似事件不多，但 2017 年的 Bitfinex 恶意软件事件显示，即使是头部机构，也难以完全避免安全风险。

操作思路
💡 我认为短期内 BTC 和 ETH 都很难摆脱大盘的调整压力，但头部机构的谨慎表态，反而可能暗示他们有更完善的安全体系，这是市场恐慌中难得的确定性。如果未来出现更大规模的传统互联网公司被攻击事件，这个判断就作废。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

translatedData.subTitle:
What frustrates many people: BTC rises while my altcoins stay flat; then altcoins take off when I’m not
on board. In fact, altcoin rotation tends to follow a rough playbook.

【Classic sequence】BTC moves first (drawing attention) → funds spill over into ETH and major coins →
Then it spreads to sector leaders → eventually sweeping up all kinds of small-cap altcoins → the whole market overheats with a broad rally, and the trend
is nearing its end. You always feel like your coin is the last to rise, because you often buy right at the end of the rotation
cycle.

The Ethereum development team has just agreed to postpone the deployment of Glamsterdam on the Hoodi testnet following warnings from ChainSecurity. Two proposals, EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, were found to carry risks of disrupting the gas fee calculation mechanism and could even cause valid transactions to be interrupted. Although no mainnet protocol has been exploited yet, the lack of a new deployment date is weighing heavily on market sentiment.

From a positioning perspective, USD 2,395.44 is the level I’m watching most closely. A close below this point → short-term selling pressure will be triggered quickly. But if buyers can hold this zone amid unfavorable technical news, that would be a sign of strength worth considering for an entry later.

For now, I’m staying on the sidelines, lowering leverage and waiting for more signals — no rush to catch a falling knife while the catalyst remains unclear. Are you holding $ETH  or waiting? 👇

BTC drops to 81561, and bulls are still paying their faith tax on schedule

Midday market recap, in four words: weakness across the board. BTC is at 81561.7, down 1.56% over 24 hours. The intraday high of 82955 has become a monument to those who chased the rally, while the low of 80888.9 is wobbling right beneath our feet. ETH is down 2.12% to 2393.32, XRP is down 2.19%, and major coins are all in the red. Only BNB, down 0.12%, is pretending to stay calm—but that’s not resilience; it’s poor liquidity. It just hasn’t had its turn to get hit yet. The most ironic part is the funding rates. After a drop like this, BTC’s rate is still 0.0067%, ETH’s 0.007%, and XRP’s 0.0087%—positive across the board. In plain English: prices are falling, but bulls are still paying by the hour and refusing to leave the table. That’s the faith tax. The more people who pay it, the more the market will make sure they learn their lesson. Directional outlook: bearish signals are clear. BTC has already fallen below the pivot at 82201.17, and the rebound can’t reclaim it—the structure is weak. The key intraday line is 80072.33, the daily buy level and the bulls’ last scrap of cover. Hold there, and only then is a recovery back to 82201 worth discussing. Break below it, and there’s nothing but a vacuum beneath—don’t talk sentiment halfway down the mountain. Resistance overhead is just as clear: the daily sell level at 83513.43 is hanging in the sky, and without volume, forget about reaching it. ETH’s script is even more straightforward: 2393.32 is lying motionless below the 2409.52 pivot. Support is at 2337.61; any rebound needs to clear 2460.03 before you start talking fantasies. Even XRP is down 2.19%. If you’re still dreaming of a broad rally, maybe take a look at the color of your holdings first. One final question: prices are down, funding rates are still positive, and retail traders are still holding on for a miracle—historically, when bulls collectively refuse to give up like this, it often isn’t the bottom. What does a real bottom look like? Funding rates turn negative, bulls surrender, and the group chat goes silent. The chat is still buzzing now, which means the show has only just begun.

BTC跌到81561，多头还在按时交信仰税

午间复盘，四个字：全面转弱。BTC报81561.7，24小时跌1.56%，日内高点82955成了追高者的纪念碑，低点80888.9就在脚下晃。ETH跌2.12%报2393.32，XRP跌2.19%，主流币集体脸色发绿，只有BNB跌0.12%假装镇定——那不是抗跌，那是流动性差，还没轮到它挨打。最讽刺的是资金费率。跌成这样，BTC费率0.0067%、ETH 0.007%、XRP 0.0087%，全线还是正的。翻译成人话：价格往下走，多头还按小时交费不肯下牌桌。这叫信仰税，交的人越多，市场越要把他们教育到位。方向判断：空头信号明显。BTC已经摔在轴心82201.17下方，反弹收不回去，结构就是弱。日内生死线看80072.33——日线买点，也是多头最后一块遮羞布。守住它，才有资格谈修复回82201；跌破，下方就是真空区，别在半山腰讲情怀。上方压力同样一目了然：83513.43日线卖点挂在天上，没量别想碰。ETH的剧本更直白：2393.32趴在轴心2409.52下方装死，支撑看2337.61，反弹先过2460.03再谈梦话。连XRP都跌2.19%了，还幻想普涨行情的，建议先看看自己的持仓颜色。最后反问一句：跌了，费率还是正的，散户还在扛单等奇迹——历史上这种多头集体不死心的阶段，往往不是底。真底长什么样？费率转负、多头缴械、群里鸦雀无声。现在群里还热闹着呢，说明戏才刚开场。
